newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil BNDES plans 8-yr, 150 mln Swiss franc bond.
newsitem.headline: Brazil BNDES plans 8-yr, 150 mln Swiss franc bond.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) said it was putting together an eight-year, 150 million Swiss franc Eurobond via CS First Boston.
"We don't want to talk about the timing or pricing of the deal because it is not finished yet," said Isabel Aboem, director of capital raising at BNDES.
Aboem said BNDES was returning to the Swiss market following good demand last year for its five-year, 7-1/8 percent bond due 2001.

BNDES, which has plans to raise a total of between $1.0 billion and $1.2 billion this year, has already issued about $300 million in Italian lira bonds and secured a $275 million syndicated loan, Aboem said.
The Swiss franc bond is equivalent to about $100 million, she said. In addition to that bond, BNDES plans to launch at least one more eurobond this year, Aboem said.
